Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWorks / Redwood Kickoff — scheduling & hosts

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We want to lock the kickoff for the BrightWorks integration so our engineers and product owners can align on authentication, data flows, and the go-live checklist. Target window is the week of Apr 20-24; preferred mornings (PT).

Quick asks from our side:
- Two 90-minute sessions: Tech intake (auth, networking, SSO) + Product alignment (use-cases, success metrics).
- We need host contacts and who will cover the run-of-show for each session.
- Any prework you want the team to do (VPN, test dataset access, sample prompts) — please send a short checklist.

Attendees (tentative): Alex Carter (BrightWorks lead), Priya Shah (PM), eng-team@brightworks.com (implementation group).

Can you propose 2 dates/times and confirm Redwood hosts?

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Carter
Head of Integrations | BrightWorks
alex.carter@brightworks.com

Subject: Re: BrightWorks / Redwood Kickoff — scheduling & hosts

Hi Alex — great to meet you virtually.

Thanks for outlining the scope. Proposed plan below (all times PT):

Option A
- Tech intake: Tue, Apr 21, 09:00–10:30 PT (Rishi lead, Jonas backup)
- Product alignment: Wed, Apr 22, 09:00–10:30 PT (Neha lead, Monica runs success metrics)

Option B
- Tech intake: Thu, Apr 23, 10:00–11:30 PT (Rishi lead)
- Product alignment: Fri, Apr 24, 08:30–10:00 PT (Neha lead)

Suggested Redwood hosts / roles
- Neha Kapoor — Customer Success (overall kickoff owner, product alignment)
- Rishi Malhotra — Solutions / tech intake lead (auth, infra, KV caching strategy)
- Jonas Weber — Observability & rollouts (tracing hooks, telemetry)
- Monica Patel — Launch ops (runbook, bridge chairs, escalation path)

Prework (short checklist attached): redwood_prework_list.csv — items: test-account creation, sample prompt set, network allowlist, SOC2 contact.

Bridge + links: we’ll create a dedicated Zoom bridge for both sessions and calendar invites once dates are confirmed.

Let me know which option works for your team and if any additional attendees should be added.

Thanks,
Neha

Alex / team — Rishi here. Option A works best for engineering on our side. A couple tech notes to flag ahead of the intake:

- For SSO, please share IdP metadata (SAML) or OIDC issuer URL before the session (we'll validate).
- If you plan to run a test dataset through the endpoint, provide a ~200-500 row CSV and the expected privacy constraints.
- We'll demo both hosted and dedicated routing in a 20-min segment; if you have strict latency targets, flag them now.

If Option A is good, I’ll carve the Zoom bridge (90m) and post the calendar invites.

Rishi
